description: Workflow Version Lineage — shows how a workflow evolved over time through generations, reflection fixes, and manual edits, with version numbers, trigger types, timestamps, and diff summaries.

groups.name: Version Timeline
groups.description: Users need a timeline of workflow versions showing version numbers, what triggered each version (generation, reflection, manual edit, fix), and when it was created.

assertions.description: Users can identify the Workflow Version Lineage panel and understand its purpose as a tool for viewing how a workflow evolved over time
Each version node displays a version number label (v1, v2, v3, etc.) so users can reference specific versions in discussions and debugging
Each version shows a trigger badge indicating what caused the version to be created (generation, reflection, manual edit, or fix)
Each version displays a formatted timestamp showing when it was created, enabling users to correlate version changes with external events

groups.name: Version Diff Summaries
groups.description: Users need diff summaries explaining what changed between versions to understand workflow evolution without reading raw JSON.

assertions.description: Each version displays a human-readable diff summary explaining what changed from the previous version, saving users from manually comparing raw workflow JSON

groups.name: Trigger Type Color Coding
groups.description: Trigger types are color-coded: green for generation, purple for reflection, blue for manual, orange for fix.

assertions.description: Trigger badges use distinct colors (green for generation, purple for reflection, blue for manual, orange for fix) so users can visually distinguish what caused each version

groups.name: Selection, Loading, and Empty States
groups.description: When no workflow is selected or no versions exist, clear messages guide the user.

assertions.description: When no workflow has been selected, users see a prompt to select a workflow, guiding them to the necessary first step

criteria.textContent: Select a workflow to view version history

assertions.description: Users see a loading indicator while version history data is being fetched, preventing confusion about a blank timeline
When a selected workflow has no version history, users see a clear message explaining that no versions exist yet

groups.name: Version Data Rendering
groups.description: Each version node must accurately render the version number, trigger type badge, formatted timestamp, and diff summary text from the API response.

assertions.description: Each version node shows the version number prefixed with 'v' (e.g. 'v1', 'v3') in semibold text
assertions.expected: Format 'v{N}' where N is the version_number integer

assertions.description: Each version shows a color-coded trigger badge indicating what caused the version: generation (green), reflection (purple), manual (blue), or fix (orange)
assertions.expected: One of: generation (green), reflection (purple), manual (blue), fix (orange)

assertions.description: Versions with a diff_summary display it in a muted background block, clamped to 2 lines, explaining what changed from the previous version
assertions.expected: Free-text summary of changes, clamped to 2 lines, in muted background — may be absent for first version

groups.name: Version Timeline Behavior
groups.description: The version timeline scrolls when versions exceed the visible area, and requires a workflow to be selected via the execution context before displaying data.

assertions.description: The component requires a workflow to be selected (from useExecution context) before fetching data — shows guidance message when none selected
assertions.precondition: No workflow is selected in the execution context

criteria.textContent: Select a workflow to view version history

assertions.description: The version list scrolls vertically when more versions exist than fit in the container (max height constrained)

states.name: No Selection — No Workflow Selected
states.description: No workflow has been selected in the execution context. The panel displays a guidance message prompting the user to select a workflow to view version history.

elements.textContent: Select a workflow to view version history

transitions.name: Select a workflow
transitions.description: User selects a workflow from the execution context, triggering a data fetch for version history

states.name: Loading — Fetching Version History
states.description: A workflow is selected and version history data is being fetched from the backend. A loading indicator is displayed to prevent confusion about a blank timeline.

transitions.name: No versions exist
transitions.description: Data fetch completes but no version history exists for the selected workflow

transitions.name: Versions found
transitions.description: Data fetch completes and one or more versions are returned, displaying the version timeline

states.name: Empty — No Version History Available
states.description: A workflow is selected but it has no version history. A clear message explains that no versions exist yet.

transitions.name: Deselect workflow
transitions.description: User deselects or switches away from the current workflow, returning to the no-selection state

states.name: Timeline — Version History Displayed
states.description: The version timeline is displayed with version nodes showing version numbers (v1, v2, etc.), color-coded trigger badges (generation/reflection/manual/fix), formatted timestamps, and diff summaries. The list scrolls vertically when versions exceed the visible area.

transitions.name: Deselect workflow
transitions.description: User deselects or switches away from the current workflow, returning to the no-selection state

transitions.name: Select a different workflow
transitions.description: User selects a different workflow, triggering a new data fetch

metadata.author: Joshua Spinak
preconditions: Requires a workflow to be selected in the execution context (useExecution hook)
Version history only exists for workflows generated after instrumentation was added
The standalone tab requires execution context — works best when embedded in Reflection Dashboard
backendDependencies: GET /graph/workflow-versions?workflow_id=<id> — returns WorkflowVersion[] ordered by version_number DESC
